checks.command: Inspection: CodeWorkspaceTab identity/sync callbacks -> CodeMirrorHost createLspCompletionSource/resolve gate/Tab acceptance -> lspCompletion fetch/resolve/plan/commit -> shared document transaction/history
checks.summary: The production completion chain freezes workspace, file, URI, language, document revision, provider generation and project-scope identity before asynchronous fetch/resolve. CodeWorkspaceTab force-syncs the live buffer and revalidates the token around provider IPC. CodeMirrorHost mounts the real LSP source and keeps completion, snippet and resolve-gate acceptance local to the editor. lspCompletion validates primary/additional ranges, combines primary edit, imports and parsed snippet text in one input.complete dispatch, and preserves selection-only snippet navigation. Timeout, failure, unavailable, cancelled, stale, policy-change and overlap outcomes remain explicit no-op or explicit-choice paths and do not silently commit old text.

5 files passed; 91/91 tests passed. Coverage includes primary plus additional edits in one dispatch, snippet placeholder mapping and choice cycling, one undo/revision, stale document/provider/policy guards, resolve timeout/failure/null/cancel, explicit retry or primary-only gate, overlap rejection, unavailable capability and mounted completion wiring.
